Terms of Service

The Royal Game of Ur for iOS and Android. Last updated 20 November 2026.

In short: The Royal Game of Ur is a game for you to play, on your own devices, with family and friends. Lumoxia owns the app, but not the ancient game it is based on. The one optional purchase is sold and handled by Apple or Google. These terms never take away a right the law gives you.

These terms are written in English. If a translation differs from the English text, the English text prevails, except where the law of your country says otherwise.

The optional purchase

The app offers one optional, one-time purchase that opens every board and stone colour. You can also unlock boards and colours for free by playing games. It is not a subscription and it does not renew.

Apple or Google sells the purchase to you. The store shows the price in your currency, with any taxes, before you buy, takes the payment, keeps the record, and handles billing, cancellations and refunds under its own rules. Lumoxia receives no payment details and cannot refund you from the app, so please ask the store.

The unlock belongs to the Apple or Google account you bought it with. On a new device, use the app’s restore option while signed in to that account. Lumoxia intends to keep the unlock working for people who bought it for as long as the app is in the stores, and will give notice on this website before it withdraws the app, where it can. It cannot promise more than that, because the stores control how purchases are delivered.

Where the store is the seller of a purchase, you can use these rights against the store as well as, where the law allows, against Lumoxia. If you live somewhere else, the mandatory consumer laws of your country apply in the same way.
